paper_title: Constraints on axions from patchy screening of the cosmic microwave background
suggested_experiment_name: unWISE Blue x Planck patchy screening
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 3
notes: First measurement of cross-correlation between axion-induced CMB patchy screening (Planck NPIPE NILC maps) and unWISE Blue galaxies. No signal detected (PTE 0.61); 95% CL one-tailed upper limit g_agamma <~ 2e-12 GeV^-1 for 1e-13 eV <~ m_a <~ 1e-12 eV, quoted as approximately mass-independent in text/abstract; encoded as a flat two-point bound over the stated validity range. The actual exclusion curve (Fig. 3) has mass dependence not tabulated in the paper text. Not a dark-matter density-dependent bound (CMB photons are the source), so no rho_DM assumption.
